snippet.title: Spacewing War 2 - 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump into this new battle in this new side-scrolling shoot’em-up, face enemies and obstacles from every corner of the Milkdromeda Galaxy and encounter strange fun transformations in Spacewing War 2!

Free demo now available on Steam!
